title: TOEIC
about: Luyện đủ 4 kỹ năng TOEIC với nội dung tự soạn theo văn phong đề thi: Nghe (Part 2-4), Đọc (Part 5-7), Nói và Viết, kèm giải thích tiếng Việt cho từng câu.

sections.title: Part 2 · Hỏi – đáp
sections.about: Part 2 kiểm tra khả năng nghe một câu hỏi hoặc câu nói ngắn rồi chọn phản hồi hợp lý nhất trong 3 lựa chọn (chỉ nghe, không đọc). Mẹo: nghe kỹ từ đầu câu (Who/When/Where/Why/How) để biết loại thông tin cần tìm, và cảnh giác với đáp án lặp lại từ trong câu hỏi hoặc có âm gần giống - đó thường là bẫy.

audio.en: When is the quarterly budget report due?
A. By the end of this week. B. In the conference room. C. Yes, it's very detailed.

questions.q: When is the quarterly budget report due?
options: By the end of this week.
questions.explain: 'When' cần mốc thời gian: 'By the end of this week'. 'In the conference room' trả lời 'Where'; 'Yes, it's very detailed' là câu Yes/No không hợp với câu hỏi Wh-.

audio.en: Who's organizing the client dinner on Friday?
A. At the Italian restaurant downtown. B. Ms. Tanaka from Sales is. C. I'd like to see the dinner menu, please.

questions.q: Who's organizing the client dinner on Friday?
options: I'd like to see the dinner menu, please.
questions.explain: 'Who' cần tên người: Ms. Tanaka. 'At the Italian restaurant' trả lời 'Where'; câu có 'dinner menu' lặp từ 'dinner' để đánh lạc hướng.

audio.en: Could you send me the updated schedule?
A. The train leaves at nine. B. He updated it yesterday. C. Sure, I'll email it this afternoon.

questions.q: Could you send me the updated schedule?
options: Sure, I'll email it this afternoon.
questions.explain: Đây là lời yêu cầu, đáp lại bằng 'Sure, I'll email it...'. 'He updated it yesterday' lặp từ 'updated' nhưng nói về người khác; 'The train leaves at nine' lạc đề.

audio.en: Why was the shipment delayed?
A. Two large boxes. B. Because of the heavy snow. C. It's on the loading dock.

questions.q: Why was the shipment delayed?
questions.explain: 'Why' cần lý do: 'Because of the heavy snow'. 'Two large boxes' trả lời 'What/How many', 'It's on the loading dock' trả lời 'Where'.

audio.en: Haven't you finished the sales presentation yet?
A. Yes, the presents were wonderful. B. At the sales department. C. Almost, I just need to add the charts.

questions.q: Haven't you finished the sales presentation yet?
options: Almost, I just need to add the charts.
questions.explain: Câu hỏi phủ định vẫn trả lời theo nội dung: gần xong rồi. 'presents' là bẫy âm thanh với 'presentation'; 'At the sales department' trả lời 'Where'.

audio.en: Where should I put these invoices?
A. In the blue folder on Ms. Lee's desk. B. About two hundred dollars. C. I'll invite them.

questions.q: Where should I put these invoices?
options: In the blue folder on Ms. Lee's desk.
questions.explain: 'Where' cần địa điểm: 'In the blue folder...'. 'I'll invite them' là bẫy âm thanh 'invoices' - 'invite'; 'About two hundred dollars' nói về số tiền.

audio.en: How much does the monthly parking pass cost?
A. From the first of the month. B. Just park in the garage. C. It's forty-five dollars.

questions.q: How much does the monthly parking pass cost?
options: From the first of the month.
questions.explain: 'How much' hỏi giá: 'forty-five dollars'. 'From the first of the month' lặp 'month' (chỉ thời điểm), 'Just park in the garage' lặp 'park' nhưng không nói giá.

audio.en: Would you like to join us for lunch, or are you too busy?
A. The lunch menu is online. B. I'll come as soon as I send this fax. C. No, it was too long.

questions.q: Would you like to join us for lunch, or are you too busy?
options: I'll come as soon as I send this fax.
questions.explain: Câu hỏi lựa chọn: tham gia hay bận. 'I'll come as soon as I send this fax' tức là sẽ đi. 'The lunch menu is online' lặp 'lunch' nhưng không trả lời; 'No, it was too long' không hợp với câu hỏi.

audio.en: The printer on the second floor is out of toner.
A. I'll call the supplier now. B. Print it on both sides. C. The florist is on the second floor.

questions.q: The printer on the second floor is out of toner.
options: The florist is on the second floor.
questions.explain: Câu trần thuật báo sự cố, phản hồi hợp lý là sẽ gọi nhà cung cấp. 'Print it on both sides' lặp 'print', còn câu về 'florist' lặp 'second floor' nhưng lạc đề.

audio.en: Do you want to take the train or drive to the conference?
A. Yes, the conference was great. B. I'll train the new staff. C. The parking is expensive downtown, so the train.

questions.q: Do you want to take the train or drive to the conference?
options: The parking is expensive downtown, so the train.
questions.explain: Câu hỏi lựa chọn 'A or B' không trả lời bằng Yes/No. Đáp án đúng chọn 'the train' kèm lý do. 'Yes, the conference was great' lặp 'conference'; 'train the new staff' lặp 'train' nhưng là động từ.

audio.en: What time does the maintenance crew arrive?
A. Around eight, before the staff comes in. B. The elevator on the left. C. He's the crew leader.

questions.q: What time does the maintenance crew arrive?
options: Around eight, before the staff comes in.
questions.explain: 'What time' cần giờ giấc: 'Around eight'. 'The elevator on the left' trả lời 'Where', 'He's the crew leader' lặp 'crew' nhưng nói về người.

audio.en: Isn't Mr. Alvarez transferring to the Seoul office?
A. Seoul is far from here. B. The office is on Main Street. C. Yes, starting next month.

questions.q: Isn't Mr. Alvarez transferring to the Seoul office?
options: The office is on Main Street.
questions.explain: Câu hỏi phủ định kiểu xác nhận, đáp lại 'Yes, starting next month'. Hai câu còn lại lặp 'Seoul'/'office' nhưng không xác nhận thông tin.

audio.en: Which candidate did the committee choose for the manager position?
A. The position paper is due Monday. B. The one with experience in logistics. C. At the committee meeting room.

questions.q: Which candidate did the committee choose for the manager position?
options: The position paper is due Monday.
The one with experience in logistics.
questions.explain: 'Which candidate' cần chọn một người: 'The one with experience in logistics'. 'position paper' lặp 'position', 'committee meeting room' lặp 'committee'.

audio.en: Let's postpone the staff meeting until Thursday.
A. Thursday works better for me, too. B. A new meeting room. C. Yes, the staff is on the third floor.

questions.q: Let's postpone the staff meeting until Thursday.
options: Thursday works better for me, too.
Yes, the staff is on the third floor.
questions.explain: Lời đề nghị, đồng ý bằng 'Thursday works better for me, too'. Hai câu còn lại lặp 'meeting'/'staff' nhưng không phản hồi đề nghị.

sections.title: Part 3 · Hội thoại
sections.about: Part 3 là các đoạn hội thoại 2-3 người ở công sở hoặc nơi cung cấp dịch vụ, mỗi đoạn kèm 3 câu hỏi. Mẹo: đọc lướt 3 câu hỏi và đáp án trước khi nghe, câu hỏi thường đi theo thứ tự thông tin trong bài nên hãy dò từng câu theo lời thoại.

audio.en: Hi Karen, did the printer deliver the new product brochures? We need them for tomorrow's trade show.
Not yet, Paul. I called them this morning, and they said a machine broke down. They can only deliver on Thursday.
Thursday? The show opens on Wednesday at nine.
I know. I'm thinking of printing a hundred copies here in our own office as a backup.
Good idea, but the color printer is out of ink.
I'll ask Ms. Gupta in Purchasing to send someone to buy a new cartridge during lunch.
Great. I'll check the files so the layout fits on both sides of the page.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: A delivery of brochures will arrive late.
A trade show has been canceled.
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nói nhà in chỉ giao được vào thứ Năm, trong khi triển lãm khai mạc thứ Tư. Các đáp án còn lại không được nhắc tới.

questions.q: What does the woman plan to do?
options: Print some copies in the office
questions.explain: Bà nói 'I'm thinking of printing a hundred copies here in our own office as a backup.' - tự in dự phòng tại văn phòng.

questions.q: What will Ms. Gupta arrange?
options: A delivery to the trade show
A meeting with the printing company
The purchase of an ink cartridge
questions.explain: Cô ấy sẽ cử người đi mua hộp mực mới ('send someone to buy a new cartridge'). Máy in hết mực chứ không hỏng, nên 'repair' là bẫy.

audio.en: Thanks for coming, everyone. We need to finalize the plans for Mr. Dawson's retirement party.
The conference room can hold forty people, but the catering company says we must confirm the headcount by Friday.
So far, thirty-two people have said yes. I'll send a reminder email today.
What about the gift? Last week we agreed on a watch.
The one we picked costs more than our budget, though. It's three hundred dollars, and we have two hundred and fifty.
I can ask each department head to chip in a little.
Please do. And I'll order a cake from the bakery on Elm Street.

questions.q: What is the meeting mainly about?
options: Hiring a caterer for a trade show
Moving into a larger conference room
questions.explain: Ngay câu đầu: 'finalize the plans for Mr. Dawson's retirement party' - bàn việc tổ chức tiệc nghỉ hưu.

questions.q: What problem does the man mention?
options: The gift costs more than the budget.
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói chiếc đồng hồ giá 300 USD trong khi ngân sách chỉ có 250 USD. Phòng chứa được 40 người, đã có 32 người đăng ký nên không thiếu chỗ.

questions.q: What does one of the women offer to do to solve the gift problem?
options: Order a cake from a bakery
questions.explain: Một người phụ nữ nói 'I can ask each department head to chip in a little' - xin các trưởng phòng góp thêm tiền. Đặt bánh và gửi email nhắc không liên quan tới vấn đề quà.

audio.en: Hello, I bought this laptop here two weeks ago, but the battery only lasts about an hour.
I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt?
Yes, here it is. I'd like to exchange it for a different model if possible.
Our policy allows exchanges within thirty days, so that's fine. The model you bought is no longer in stock, though. The next one up costs eighty dollars more.
Hmm. Does it come with a longer warranty?
Yes, three years instead of one. And I can take ten percent off, since you're a rewards member.
In that case, I'll take it.

questions.q: Where most likely are the speakers?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ mang laptop đến đổi, người đàn ông nói về chính sách đổi hàng và bảo hành - đây là cửa hàng điện tử.

questions.q: What does the man say about the new model?
options: It costs more than the original.
questions.explain: Ông nói mẫu tiếp theo 'costs eighty dollars more' (đắt hơn 80 USD). Mẫu cũ mới là mẫu hết hàng; bảo hành mẫu mới dài hơn (3 năm).

questions.q: What does the man offer the woman?
questions.explain: 'I can take ten percent off, since you're a rewards member' - giảm 10% cho hội viên.

audio.en: Travel desk, this is Omar.
Hi Omar, it's Linda Park from Accounting. I need to change my flight to the Chicago workshop. My meeting with the auditors was moved to Tuesday morning.
Your current flight leaves Tuesday at seven a.m. There's another at one thirty that afternoon, and it has an open aisle seat.
One thirty works. Will I still arrive before the opening dinner?
Yes, you'll land at three fifteen. The dinner starts at six thirty at the hotel.
Perfect. Please also email the new itinerary to my manager.
Will do. There's a fifty-dollar change fee, which I'll charge to your department.

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?
questions.explain: Bà muốn đổi chuyến bay vì cuộc họp với kiểm toán bị dời sang sáng thứ Ba.

questions.q: What time will the woman arrive in Chicago?
questions.explain: Người đàn ông nói 'you'll land at three fifteen'. 1:30 là giờ cất cánh, 6:30 là giờ bữa tối.

questions.q: What will the man charge to the woman's department?
questions.explain: 'There's a fifty-dollar change fee, which I'll charge to your department' - phí đổi vé 50 USD.

audio.en: Thanks for joining. Our new website launches in two weeks, and the testing team found several issues.
The biggest one is the checkout page, Mr. Reyes. It freezes when customers use certain mobile browsers.
My developers are already working on it. We should have a fix by Monday.
Good. Is the product video ready, Ana?
Almost. The narrator re-recorded the script, and I'm waiting for the final version.
Let me know if you need extra budget for editing.
One more thing. Should we tell current customers about the launch date?
Yes, Ana, please include it in next week's newsletter.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the conversation?
options: The launch of a new website
The hiring of a video narrator
A change in a delivery date
questions.explain: Câu đầu tiên đã nêu: website mới ra mắt sau hai tuần và nhóm kiểm thử tìm thấy một số lỗi.

questions.q: What does one of the women say about the developers?
options: They are fixing a checkout problem.
questions.explain: 'My developers are already working on it' - 'it' là lỗi trang thanh toán, dự kiến xong vào thứ Hai.

questions.q: What is Ana asked to do?
options: Announce the launch date to customers
questions.explain: Ông Reyes bảo Ana đưa ngày ra mắt vào bản tin tuần sau ('include it in next week's newsletter').

audio.en: Mr. Ito, I'm calling about the parking garage. A notice says it will close next week.
Yes, the garage is being repainted from Monday to Wednesday. Employees can use the lot behind the library instead.
Is that lot free?
It is for our staff. Just show your company ID at the gate. There's also a shuttle every fifteen minutes.
That sounds convenient. I have a client visiting on Tuesday, though. Where should she park?
Visitors can use the spaces in front of the lobby. I'll ask security to reserve one for her.
Thank you. Do you need her name?
Yes, just send it to me by email and I'll pass it along.

questions.q: What will happen to the garage next week?
questions.explain: 'The garage is being repainted from Monday to Wednesday' - garage được sơn lại.

questions.q: What must employees show at the gate?
questions.explain: 'Just show your company ID at the gate' - xuất trình thẻ nhân viên.

questions.q: What does the man offer to do?
options: Ask security to reserve a space
questions.explain: 'I'll ask security to reserve one for her' - nhờ bảo vệ giữ một chỗ cho khách của bà.

sections.title: Part 4 · Bài nói ngắn
sections.about: Part 4 gồm bài nói một người (thông báo, tin nhắn thoại, quảng cáo, hướng dẫn tham quan, bản tin) kèm 3 câu hỏi. Mẹo: xác định ngay người nói, người nghe và mục đích từ 1-2 câu đầu; thông tin 'sắp làm gì' thường nằm ở những câu cuối.

audio.en: Attention, all Harbor Point Logistics employees.
The company email system will be offline for maintenance this Saturday from ten p.m. until two a.m. on Sunday.
During that time, you will not be able to send or receive messages, or open shared calendars.
If you need to send an urgent document to a client, please do so before six p.m. on Friday.
The IT department also reminds everyone to change their passwords before the update. Instructions are posted on the intranet.
If you have any questions, contact the help desk at extension four-four-one-seven. Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.q: What is being announced?
questions.explain: Bài nói thông báo hệ thống email sẽ ngừng để bảo trì vào tối thứ Bảy.

questions.q: What are employees advised to do before Friday evening?
questions.explain: 'If you need to send an urgent document to a client, please do so before six p.m. on Friday.'

questions.q: Where can employees find password instructions?
questions.explain: 'Instructions are posted on the intranet' - hướng dẫn nằm trên mạng nội bộ. Email sẽ bị gián đoạn nên không phải đáp án.

audio.en: Hello, this message is for Ms. Rivera. This is Daniel from Brightline Office Supplies.
I'm calling about your order of twelve office chairs.
Unfortunately, the black model is out of stock until the end of the month.
We do have the same chair in gray, and I can deliver it by Thursday at no extra charge.
If you'd rather wait for the black one, I can give you a ten percent discount.
Please call me back at five-five-five, zero-one-three-six, before noon tomorrow so I can confirm the delivery.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
questions.explain: Mẫu ghế màu đen hết hàng đến cuối tháng - đó là lý do gọi.

questions.q: What does the speaker offer?
options: A different color at no extra delivery charge
questions.explain: Ghế màu xám có sẵn, giao trước thứ Năm và không tính thêm phí ('at no extra charge').

questions.q: What does the speaker ask Ms. Rivera to do?
options: Return the call by tomorrow noon
questions.explain: 'Please call me back ... before noon tomorrow' - gọi lại trước trưa mai.

audio.en: Are your spreadsheets slowing you down?
At Kessler Business Academy, our one-day workshops teach you the shortcuts that save hours every week.
Classes are held on the second Saturday of every month, and each group is limited to fifteen people, so you get personal attention.
Register online before March thirty-first and receive a twenty percent discount.
Visit kessler academy dot com, or call five-five-five, zero-one-eight-two.
Kessler Business Academy. Work smarter.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.explain: Quảng cáo giới thiệu các buổi workshop một ngày của Kessler Business Academy. 'Spreadsheet' chỉ là nội dung được dạy, không phải sản phẩm.

questions.q: What is mentioned as a benefit of the classes?
questions.explain: Mỗi nhóm tối đa 15 người 'so you get personal attention' - lớp nhỏ nên được kèm kỹ.

questions.q: How can listeners get a discount?
questions.explain: 'Register online before March thirty-first and receive a twenty percent discount' - đăng ký trực tuyến sớm.

audio.en: Welcome to the Alderbrook Chocolate Factory tour. My name is Gina, and I'll be your guide this morning.
We'll begin in the roasting room, where the cocoa beans are prepared.
Please stay behind the yellow line, and note that photography is not allowed in the packaging area.
The tour lasts about forty-five minutes, so please keep your visitor badges visible at all times.
When we finish, we'll walk to the gift shop, where you can taste our new dark chocolate.

questions.q: Who is the speaker?
questions.explain: 'I'll be your guide this morning' - cô là hướng dẫn viên.

questions.q: What are listeners not allowed to do in the packaging area?
questions.explain: 'Photography is not allowed in the packaging area' - cấm chụp ảnh. Huy hiệu khách thì phải đeo.

questions.q: What will listeners do at the end of the tour?
questions.explain: 'In the gift shop, you can taste our new dark chocolate' - nếm thử sản phẩm mới.

audio.en: In business news, Fairview Electronics announced today that it will open a second factory in Greenfield, creating about three hundred new jobs.
The company's chief executive, Marta Silva, said construction will begin in April and the factory should be operating by next year.
Local officials welcomed the plan, noting that unemployment in the area has risen over the past year.
Residents can learn more at a public meeting at Greenfield Town Hall on Thursday evening.
Now, let's turn to the weather.

questions.q: What is the news report about?
questions.explain: Công ty Fairview Electronics sẽ mở nhà máy thứ hai ở Greenfield, tạo khoảng 300 việc làm.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the schedule?
questions.explain: 'Construction will begin in April and the factory should be operating by next year.'

questions.q: What can residents do on Thursday evening?
questions.explain: 'Residents can learn more at a public meeting ... on Thursday evening.'

sections.title: Part 5 · Hoàn thành câu
sections.about: Part 5 kiểm tra ngữ pháp và từ vựng qua câu có một chỗ trống, chọn 1 trong 4 đáp án (từ loại, thì, giới từ, liên từ, đại từ, từ vựng). Mẹo: nhìn các đáp án cùng gốc từ để biết đây là câu hỏi từ loại, xác định vị trí chỗ trống (trước danh từ, sau 'be'...) rồi chọn nhanh trong khoảng 20 giây.

questions.q: The new hires received _____ training on the company's accounting software.
questions.explain: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ 'training' nên cần tính từ: 'extensive' (toàn diện). 'extension' là danh từ, 'extend' là động từ, 'extensively' là trạng từ.

questions.q: Ms. Okafor was _____ praised for her handling of the Peterson account.
questions.explain: Trước động từ phân từ 'praised' cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa: 'highly praised' (được khen ngợi hết lời). 'high' là tính từ/trạng từ chỉ độ cao nên không hợp.

questions.q: The _____ of the new inventory system will take place over the weekend.
questions.explain: Sau mạo từ 'The' và trước 'of' cần danh từ: 'installation' (việc cài đặt). Các dạng còn lại là động từ hoặc phân từ.

questions.q: Customers are _____ to return items within thirty days for a full refund.
questions.explain: Cấu trúc bị động 'be encouraged to + V': khách hàng được khuyến khích trả hàng. 'encouraging' mang nghĩa chủ động nên sai.

questions.q: Please submit your expense reports _____ by the fifteenth of each month.
questions.explain: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'submit': 'promptly' (đúng hạn, ngay). 'prompt' là tính từ, 'promptness' là danh từ.

questions.q: The marketing team's _____ proposal impressed the board of directors.
questions.explain: Trước danh từ 'proposal' cần tính từ: 'creative' (sáng tạo). 'creativity' là danh từ, 'creatively' là trạng từ.

questions.q: Employees who wish to attend the seminar must complete the _____ form online.
questions.explain: Danh từ ghép 'registration form' (mẫu đăng ký): danh từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ. 'registered form' không tự nhiên trong ngữ cảnh này.

questions.q: By the time the auditors arrive next Monday, we _____ all the records.
questions.explain: 'By the time + hiện tại đơn (arrive)' chỉ tương lai, mệnh đề chính dùng tương lai hoàn thành: 'will have organized'.

questions.q: Since Ms. Duarte joined the company in 2019, sales in the Brazilian market _____ by nearly forty percent.
questions.explain: 'Since + mốc quá khứ' đi với hiện tại hoàn thành; chủ ngữ 'sales' số nhiều nên dùng 'have grown'.

questions.q: When the power went out, the technicians _____ the servers.
questions.explain: Hành động đang diễn ra thì bị một sự việc khác xen vào ('went out'): dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn 'were upgrading'.

questions.q: If the supplier _____ the shipment by Friday, we will miss the product launch.
questions.explain: Câu điều kiện loại 1 (mệnh đề chính 'will miss') thì mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn: 'doesn't deliver'.

questions.q: All visitors _____ to sign in at the front desk before entering the building.
questions.explain: 'Visitors' là đối tượng chịu tác động nên dùng bị động: 'are required to + V' (được yêu cầu phải).

questions.q: The annual shareholders' meeting is scheduled _____ April 12.
questions.explain: Dùng 'on' trước ngày cụ thể (April 12). 'in' dùng với tháng/năm, 'at' với giờ.

questions.q: Ms. Tran has been responsible _____ the Asia-Pacific accounts since last year.
questions.explain: Cụm cố định 'be responsible for' (chịu trách nhiệm về).

questions.q: All applications must be received _____ Friday, June 3, to be considered.
questions.explain: 'by + mốc thời gian' nghĩa là chậm nhất vào lúc đó, đúng với thông báo hạn nộp hồ sơ. 'during' đi với khoảng thời gian.

questions.q: The new office is located _____ the street from the central post office.
questions.explain: 'across the street from' nghĩa là ở phía đối diện đường. Các giới từ còn lại không tạo cụm này.

questions.q: Mr. Kim will be on vacation _____ two weeks beginning next Monday.
questions.explain: 'for + khoảng thời gian' (for two weeks). 'since' đi với mốc thời gian trong quá khứ.

questions.q: _____ the weather was bad, the outdoor event went ahead as planned.
questions.explain: Hai vế đối lập (thời tiết xấu nhưng sự kiện vẫn diễn ra) nên dùng 'Although' (mặc dù).

questions.q: Please call the help desk _____ you have trouble logging in to the system.
questions.explain: Điều kiện: 'nếu bạn gặp sự cố đăng nhập' thì hãy gọi. 'unless' (trừ khi) làm câu sai nghĩa.

questions.q: The store will remain open late _____ all customers have been served.
questions.explain: 'until' (cho đến khi) + mệnh đề. 'during' là giới từ nên không đi với mệnh đề; 'while' và 'since' sai nghĩa.

questions.q: Applicants must submit _____ a résumé and two letters of recommendation.
questions.explain: Cặp 'both ... and ...' (cả ... lẫn ...). 'either' cần 'or', 'neither' cần 'nor'.

questions.q: The company plans to _____ its product line to include several eco-friendly items.
questions.explain: 'expand' (mở rộng) hợp với 'product line'. Các từ còn lại chỉ giống hình thức: giải thích, hết hạn, bày tỏ.

questions.q: The hotel offers a _____ breakfast to all guests staying more than two nights.
questions.explain: 'complimentary' = miễn phí, tặng kèm. 'complementary' (bổ sung) là từ dễ nhầm.

questions.q: Because of a scheduling _____, two meetings were booked in the same room.
questions.explain: 'scheduling conflict' là cụm cố định, nghĩa là trùng lịch.

questions.q: The finance department will _____ all travel expenses within five business days.
questions.explain: 'reimburse expenses' (hoàn trả chi phí). Các động từ còn lại không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: The _____ of the contract include a thirty-day cancellation notice.
questions.explain: 'the terms of the contract' là các điều khoản hợp đồng.

questions.q: Ms. Hall asked Mr. Wu to send _____ the sales figures before the meeting.
questions.explain: Sau động từ 'send' cần tân ngữ: 'her'. 'she' là chủ ngữ, 'hers' là đại từ sở hữu, 'herself' là đại từ phản thân.

questions.q: Our clients appreciate that we always return _____ calls within one hour.
questions.explain: Trước danh từ 'calls' cần tính từ sở hữu: 'their calls' (cuộc gọi của họ).

questions.q: The manager reviewed the proposal _____ before approving the budget.
questions.explain: Đại từ phản thân 'himself' nhấn mạnh chính người quản lý tự xem xét đề xuất.

questions.q: The two departments share an office, and _____ often work together on projects.
questions.explain: Làm chủ ngữ của động từ 'work' nên dùng 'they'.

sections.title: Part 6 · Hoàn thành đoạn văn
sections.about: Part 6 là đoạn văn ngắn (email, thông báo, memo) có 4 chỗ trống: điền từ/cụm từ hoặc chọn câu thích hợp. Mẹo: với câu chèn vào, hãy đọc câu trước và câu sau chỗ trống, tìm đáp án khớp về chủ đề và có từ nối (this, also, however...) với hai câu đó.

items.title: Email: quy định đỗ xe
items.passage:
To: All Employees
From: Facilities Office
Subject: New parking permits

Starting on March 1, all employees who park in the Delmar Street garage [1] to display a permit on the windshield. Permits can be picked up at the Facilities Office on the second floor [2] 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. on weekdays. [3] Employees who arrive without a valid permit will be asked to move their vehicles. Please note that visitor parking is [4] on the north side of the building.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [1]
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ 'all employees' chịu tác động nên dùng bị động 'are required to display' (được yêu cầu phải dán).

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [2]
questions.explain: Cấu trúc 'between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.' (từ 9 giờ sáng đến 5 giờ chiều). 'from' phải đi với 'to'.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [3]
options: Please note that enforcement will begin on March 8.
The Facilities Office has moved to the first floor.
The cafeteria will close early on March 1.
questions.explain: Câu sau nói về nhân viên không có thẻ sẽ bị yêu cầu dời xe, nên câu điền vào phải nói về việc bắt đầu áp dụng quy định. Câu về tầng 1 mâu thuẫn với 'second floor'.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [4]
questions.explain: Sau 'is' cần tính từ: 'available' (có sẵn).

items.title: Thông báo: sửa sảnh tòa nhà
items.passage:
NOTICE TO TENANTS

Beginning June 10, the lobby of the Kingsford Building will undergo renovation. The work [1] approximately three weeks. During this time, the main entrance on Park Avenue will be closed, and all visitors should [2] the side entrance on Wells Street. [3] The elevators will remain in service throughout the project. We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your [4]. Questions may be directed to the building manager, Ms. Nadia Brooks, at 555-0147.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [1]
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ 'The work' là vật nên dùng bị động 'is expected to last' (dự kiến kéo dài). 'expects' cần chủ ngữ là người.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [2]
questions.explain: Sau 'should' dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: 'should use'.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [3]
options: Parking fees will increase in July.
Signs will be posted to show visitors the way.
Tenants must renew their leases by May.
questions.explain: Sau khi nói lối vào chính đóng, câu hợp lý là sẽ có biển chỉ dẫn. Các câu còn lại không liên quan tới việc sửa sảnh.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [4]
questions.explain: Sau 'your' cần danh từ: 'patience' (sự kiên nhẫn). 'patients' nghĩa là bệnh nhân.

items.title: Memo: báo cáo chi phí
items.passage:
MEMO
To: Sales Team
From: Rebecca Thornton, Finance Director
Date: October 4
Re: Expense reports

Beginning next month, all expense reports must be submitted through the new online system [1] paper forms. Each report should include scanned copies of receipts for [2] purchase over twenty dollars. [3] Reports that are incomplete will be returned to the sender, which may delay reimbursement. A training session will be held on October 18, and attendance is [4] for all sales staff.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [1]
questions.explain: 'instead of + danh từ' nghĩa là thay vì. Các từ còn lại là liên từ, không đứng trước 'paper forms'.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [2]
questions.explain: Sau chỗ trống là danh từ đếm được số ít 'purchase' nên dùng 'every'. 'all/many/several' đi với danh từ số nhiều.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [3]
options: Receipts must be clear enough to show the date and amount.
The new system was developed in Canada.
Sales have risen steadily since spring.
Our offices will be closed on Friday.
questions.explain: Câu trước nhắc tới biên lai và câu sau nói báo cáo thiếu sẽ bị trả lại, nên câu điền vào nên nói về yêu cầu với biên lai.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [4]
questions.explain: Sau 'is' cần tính từ: 'mandatory' (bắt buộc).

items.title: Email: mời phỏng vấn
items.passage:
To: Hiroshi Mori
From: Cathy Lindgren, Human Resources
Subject: Your application

Dear Mr. Mori,

Thank you for [1] for the Project Coordinator position at Silverline Engineering. We were impressed by your résumé and would like to invite you for an interview on Wednesday, November 9, at 10 a.m. [2] you are unable to attend at that time, please let me know and we will arrange another date. [3] Please bring a photo ID, as you will need to sign in at the security desk. We [4] forward to meeting you.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [1]
questions.explain: Sau giới từ 'for' dùng V-ing: 'Thank you for applying'.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [2]
questions.explain: Mệnh đề điều kiện 'Nếu bạn không thể đến vào giờ đó thì hãy báo cho tôi': 'If'. 'Unless' làm đảo nghĩa.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [3]
options: Your salary will be paid monthly.
The interview will last about one hour and will be held in Room 402.
Your references will not be needed.
questions.explain: Câu sau bàn việc mang theo giấy tờ khi đến phỏng vấn, nên câu điền vào phải cho thông tin về buổi phỏng vấn.

questions.q: Chọn từ/câu cho chỗ trống [4]
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ 'We' dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: 'We look forward to meeting you'. 'looking' đứng riêng mà không có 'are' thì sai.

sections.title: Part 7 · Đọc hiểu
sections.about: Part 7 gồm các văn bản thực tế (email, quảng cáo, bài báo, tin nhắn, cặp văn bản liên quan) kèm 2-5 câu hỏi. Mẹo: đọc câu hỏi trước, gạch từ khóa rồi dò trong bài; với hai văn bản, câu hỏi suy luận thường cần ghép thông tin từ cả hai.

items.title: Email: kiểm tra an toàn
items.passage:
From: Teresa Molina
To: All Department Managers
Date: September 12
Subject: Annual safety inspection

Dear Managers,

This is a reminder that the annual fire-safety inspection of our Riverside campus will take place on Tuesday, September 24. Inspectors from the city fire department will visit every floor between 9:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m.

Please make sure that hallways and emergency exits in your areas are clear of boxes and equipment. Each department must also confirm that its fire extinguishers have been checked since last March; the tag on each unit shows the date. If a tag is out of date, contact Facilities by September 18 so that a technician can replace the unit before the inspection.

Employees do not need to leave the building, but the inspectors may ask a few questions about evacuation procedures. A short guide is attached.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Teresa Molina
Facilities Director

questions.q: What is the purpose of the email?
options: To prepare managers for an inspection
To announce a new safety policy
To request a repair of the building
To introduce a new city regulation
questions.explain: Email nhắc các quản lý chuẩn bị cho đợt kiểm tra an toàn phòng cháy ('This is a reminder...').

questions.q: What are managers asked to do if an extinguisher tag is out of date?
options: Report it to the fire department
questions.explain: 'If a tag is out of date, contact Facilities by September 18' - liên hệ bộ phận Facilities chậm nhất ngày 18/9.

questions.q: What is indicated about the inspection?
options: It will take place at several campuses.
It will be conducted by company staff.
Employees may be asked about evacuation procedures.
It will require employees to leave the building.
questions.explain: 'The inspectors may ask a few questions about evacuation procedures' - nhân viên có thể bị hỏi về quy trình sơ tán. Nhân viên không cần rời tòa nhà, và người kiểm tra là sở cứu hỏa thành phố.

items.title: Quảng cáo dịch vụ ăn uống
items.passage:

questions.q: Who can receive free delivery?
options: Customers whose events are within 15 miles
questions.explain: 'Free delivery and setup for events within 15 miles of our kitchen' - sự kiện trong bán kính 15 dặm. Giảm giá 10% mới áp dụng cho 50 khách trở lên.

questions.q: What is new this season?
questions.explain: 'New this season: our boxed lunches now come in recyclable packaging.' Khay tráng miệng miễn phí là ưu đãi khi nhắc quảng cáo, không phải điều mới của mùa này.

items.title: Bài báo: tiệm bánh mở chi nhánh
items.passage:
Local Bakery Opens Second Shop

WESTBROOK (May 3) - Sunrise Bakery, a family-owned business known for its sourdough bread, opened its second location on Maple Street on Saturday. Owner Luis Fernandez said the new shop was made possible by a small-business loan he received last autumn.

"Our original shop on Fifth Avenue has been so busy that customers often wait in line for thirty minutes," Mr. Fernandez said. "The new location has more seating and a larger kitchen, so we can bake more bread each morning."

The new shop has hired eight employees, most of them recent graduates of the culinary program at Westbrook Community College. Mr. Fernandez plans to offer baking classes for the public on Sunday afternoons beginning in June.

Both shops are open from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday through Saturday.

questions.q: Why did Mr. Fernandez open a second shop?
options: The first shop had too many customers.
questions.explain: Ông nói cửa hàng gốc quá đông, khách phải xếp hàng khoảng 30 phút.

questions.q: What is suggested about the new employees?
options: They have worked at the original shop.
Many studied at a local college.
questions.explain: 'Most of them recent graduates of the culinary program at Westbrook Community College' - phần lớn vừa tốt nghiệp chương trình ẩm thực của trường địa phương.

questions.q: What will happen in June?
options: Both shops will extend their hours.
Sourdough bread will go on sale.
questions.explain: 'Baking classes for the public on Sunday afternoons beginning in June' - lớp học làm bánh bắt đầu vào tháng Sáu.

items.title: Chat hỗ trợ kỹ thuật
items.passage:
Online Chat - Meridian Tech Support

Amir Hassan (10:02 a.m.): Hello, I'm having trouble connecting to the office VPN from home. It keeps saying "authentication failed."
Lena Cho (10:03 a.m.): Hi Amir, I can help. Did you change your network password recently?
Amir Hassan (10:04 a.m.): Yes, on Monday. I haven't updated it on my laptop, though.
Lena Cho (10:05 a.m.): That's probably the cause. Please open the VPN settings and enter the new password.
Amir Hassan (10:08 a.m.): I did that, but it's still not working.
Lena Cho (10:09 a.m.): Sometimes the old login is saved. Could you delete the saved profile and restart the program?
Amir Hassan (10:12 a.m.): That worked! I'm connected now. Thank you.
Lena Cho (10:13 a.m.): Great. I'll send you a short guide so you can do it yourself next time. Is there anything else I can help with?
Amir Hassan (10:13 a.m.): No, that's all. Thanks again.

questions.q: What problem did Mr. Hassan report?
options: He could not connect to the VPN.
questions.explain: Ông Hassan nói không kết nối được VPN văn phòng từ nhà, báo lỗi 'authentication failed'.

questions.q: At 10:05 a.m., what does Ms. Cho most likely mean when she writes, "That's probably the cause"?
options: The VPN program is out of date.
The laptop still has the old password.
questions.explain: Ông Hassan đổi mật khẩu hôm thứ Hai nhưng chưa cập nhật trên laptop, nên 'the cause' là laptop vẫn lưu mật khẩu cũ.

questions.q: What will Ms. Cho do next?
questions.explain: 'I'll send you a short guide so you can do it yourself next time.'

items.title: Tin tuyển dụng và email ứng tuyển

questions.q: What benefit is offered to applicants from outside Washington State?
questions.explain: 'Paid relocation assistance for candidates living outside Washington State' - hỗ trợ chi phí chuyển chỗ ở.

questions.q: What was missing from Mr. Bell's application on June 10?
questions.explain: Ông nói chưa kịp hoàn thành thư xin việc nên chưa đính kèm ('I could not finish my cover letter').

sections.title: Speaking · Nói
sections.about: Phần Nói gồm đọc to đoạn văn, trả lời câu hỏi ngắn và nêu ý kiến trong 60 giây. Mẹo: ưu tiên nói trôi chảy, rõ ràng và đủ ý; khi nêu ý kiến hãy theo khuôn: quan điểm, hai lý do có ví dụ, kết luận.

items.promptVi: Thông báo ở sân bay: chuyến bay bị hoãn do sương mù.
items.sample: Attention, passengers on flight 218 to Denver. Because of heavy fog, departure has been delayed by approximately forty minutes. We apologize for the inconvenience. Passengers who wish to change their travel plans may speak with an agent at gate twelve. Free refreshments are available in the lounge. Please keep your boarding pass with you at all times.
tips: Dùng 45 giây chuẩn bị để đọc lướt, đánh dấu chỗ ngắt hơi và các từ khó (số, tên riêng).
Lên giọng ở cuối câu hỏi hoặc danh sách, xuống giọng ở cuối câu trần thuật.
Đọc rõ phụ âm cuối (-s, -ed, -t) và nhấn đúng trọng âm từ dài.

items.promptVi: Quảng cáo phòng tập thể dục.
items.sample: Welcome to Maplewood Fitness Center, the neighborhood's newest place to stay healthy. Our modern gym offers over fifty weekly classes, from yoga to cycling, and personal trainers are available seven days a week. Sign up this month and enjoy your first three months at half price. items.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Companies should allow employees to work flexible hours. Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion. Write at least 300 words.

items.sample:
I strongly agree that companies should allow employees to work flexible hours, provided that the work is still completed on time. In my view, this policy benefits both workers and employers.

First, flexible hours help employees manage their personal lives. Many people have responsibilities outside the office, such as taking children to school or caring for elderly relatives. If a company lets them start work at ten o'clock instead of eight, they can handle these duties without stress. A calmer employee is usually more focused and makes fewer mistakes. In addition, workers who live far from the office can avoid the busiest traffic, which saves them time and money every week.

Second, flexibility can actually raise productivity. People do not all have the same energy levels during the day. Some are most creative in the early morning, while others work best in the afternoon or evening. When employees choose the hours that suit them, they can do their most demanding tasks at their best time. At my previous company, our design team switched to flexible schedules, and the number of projects delivered ahead of the deadline rose noticeably within six months.

Third, a flexible policy helps a company attract and keep talented staff. Job seekers today often ask about working conditions before they ask about salary. A company that trusts its employees will have a better reputation and will lose fewer people to competitors. Hiring and training new staff is expensive, so keeping good workers saves money.

Of course, there are some risks. Teams may find it harder to schedule meetings if everyone arrives at different times. However, this problem can be solved by setting core hours, for example from eleven to three, when everyone must be available. Managers can also use shared calendars and messaging tools to stay in touch.

In conclusion, flexible working hours make employees happier and more productive, and they give companies a real advantage in the job market. With clear rules about core hours and deadlines, the benefits far outweigh the difficulties.

items.prompt: Some people think a company should hire experienced workers, while others believe it is better to hire recent graduates and train them. Which do you think is better? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion. Write at least 300 words.

items.sample:
In my opinion, a company should hire a mixture of experienced professionals and new graduates, but if it must choose only one, training graduates is often the wiser long-term investment.

Experienced employees clearly have advantages. They already know how to do the job, so they need little supervision and can start producing results almost immediately. This is especially important for senior positions, where mistakes can cost a company a great deal of money. For example, a hospital cannot afford to wait while a new manager learns the basics of patient scheduling. Experienced workers also bring ideas and contacts from their previous employers, which can help the business grow.

However, they also have disadvantages. Experienced candidates usually expect higher salaries and may be less willing to change their habits. If they have worked in a different company culture for many years, they sometimes find it difficult to accept new procedures. In contrast, recent graduates are generally more flexible and eager to learn. They are comfortable with new technology and often have fresh ideas because they have not yet formed fixed opinions about how things should be done.

Training graduates can also build loyalty. When a company invests time in teaching young people, they tend to feel grateful and stay longer. Over five or ten years, the company may end up with managers who understand its values and products better than any outsider could. A software firm I know hires graduates every summer and promotes the best of them within three years. As a result, it rarely needs to recruit from outside.

On the other hand, training takes time and money, and not every company can afford it. A small business with only a few employees may not have anyone who can teach a beginner. In that case, hiring someone with experience is the more practical choice.

To sum up, experienced staff provide immediate skills, while graduates provide energy and long-term loyalty. The best approach is to combine the two groups so that they can learn from each other.

items.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Online meetings are just as effective as face-to-face meetings. Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion. Write at least 300 words.
items.promptVi: Họp trực tuyến có hiệu quả ngang họp trực tiếp không? (tối thiểu 300 từ).
items.sample:
I partly agree that online meetings can be as effective as face-to-face meetings, but this depends on the purpose of the meeting and the people involved.

For routine tasks, online meetings are very effective. Weekly progress updates or short planning sessions do not require everyone to be in the same room. By using video calls, a team can save the time and money spent on travelling. For instance, my company has offices in three cities, and a single video call replaces what once required a day of travel. Online tools also make it easy to share documents on the screen, record the discussion and send notes to everyone afterward, which reduces misunderstandings.

Online meetings are also more inclusive in some ways. Employees who work from home or live in other countries can join with no extra cost. Quiet people who dislike speaking in a crowded room sometimes feel more comfortable typing their ideas into the chat window.

Nevertheless, there are situations where meeting in person is clearly better. When people are negotiating a contract or solving a sensitive problem, body language and tone of voice are very important. On a screen, it is harder to notice small signs that someone is confused or unhappy. Connection problems can also interrupt the discussion, and people often become distracted by their phones or emails when they are not in the same room. Building trust with a new client is another case. A handshake and a shared lunch usually create a stronger relationship than a series of video calls.

Therefore, I believe companies should decide case by case. Short, practical meetings can be held online, while important discussions that involve trust, creativity or conflict should take place face to face. If managers choose the right format for each meeting, they will use time wisely and keep their teams productive.

In conclusion, online meetings are a valuable tool, but they cannot completely replace meeting in person. By combining both formats sensibly, a company can enjoy the savings of technology without losing the human connection that makes teams work well.
